text:
emma: Postmortem follow-up for Tessera customer incident. TL;DR: peering churn + asymmetric route acceptance + on-prem appliance clearing conn state caused steady-state isolation for a subset of pods. Need owners for remediation, short timelines, and a check to detect similar regressions automatically.

li: I can take the peering choreography fixes. I'll add guards so route updates from a peer in TRANSITION state are applied slowly (staged apply) and instrument timing. ETA 4 working days.

sam: I'll drive the on-prem appliance conversation. Customer uses vendorX firewall with aggressive conntrack timeout and a default reorder handling bug. Asking for vendor firmware/patch timeline; meanwhile propose app-side keepalive and a recommended conntrack profile.

jess: From logs we saw repeated "PEER_CHANGE" events then a flood of "RT_ACCEPT" followed by TCP RSTs. Snip of peering-agent: ```text
[2026-03-18T11:04:12Z] PEER_CHANGE peer=vpc-abc state=staged
[2026-03-18T11:04:13Z] RT_ACCEPT prefix=10.20.0.0/16 src=peer id=42
[2026-03-18T11:04:14Z] TCP_RST src=10.20.1.4 dst=10.20.2.9
```

emma: Proposed checklist (short):
- [ ] Owner: li - implement staged-route-apply + unit tests, add e2e harness to simulate peer churn (due 2026-03-31) - PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/peering/pulls/1188
- [ ] Owner: sam - vendor engagement + fallback keepalive pattern & customer config doc (due 2026-03-29) - TICKET: NET-7722
- [ ] Owner: jess - add a "peer-transit" passive alert (transition > 20s) and attach historical incidents (due 2026-04-02) - ALERT-334
- [ ] Owner: emma - update Dedicated runbook with emergency isolation steps & rollback checklist (due 2026-04-05) - PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/2042

infra-bot: Created tracking epic -> https://issues.internal/RED-EPIC-9006 :package:

li: For the harness I'll include a flag to vary CT timeouts and flap cadence. Sharing a draft branch midweek.

sam: Customer asked for minimal-change ops first. I'll send recommended conntrack profile + sample iptables keepalive rule and ask for a maintenance window. If vendor patch ETA > 2 weeks, we'll push keepalive as stopgap.

jess: Also proposing a regression metric: %connections reset within 60s after route accept. I can add a dashboard and an alert threshold.

incident-bot: Reminder: link all PRs and tickets to INC-9123 for audit trail.

emma: Scheduling a 20-min sync Friday 10:00 PT to review PRs and vendor update. Drop blockers here if you can't attend. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
